projects.title: Doom recreation in Phaser 3
projects.shortDesc: A recreation of the original Doom made by scratch using Phaser 3, mathematics and sweat.

generalInfo.desc: After being amazed with the origin story of the development of the original Doom and starting being passionate about early days of graphics programming, I decided to recreate the original Doom using Phaser 3. The project is still ongoing but I have made a lot of progress recreating the raycasting engine, the level system, the enemies AI and the weapons mechanics.

detailedInfo.title: Starting the project, creation of the 2D world.
paragraphs: After investigating about how the original Doom was done, I realized that I wanted to start with something a little bit easier. So I decided to recreate the Wolfenstein 3D system, which uses a simple raycast system.

projects.title: Operation Bloody Xmas in Phaser 3
projects.shortDesc: My original 2D pixelart game with a different aproach from the classical christmas story. Got to finish it some day...

projects.title: Souls-Like Game Project
projects.shortDesc: A really ambitious project where I was the main leader of a small dev group, there's a lot to learn so we paused it and we will resume it when we are ready.

projects.title: Archer Game
projects.shortDesc: A project where I was exploring the archer mechanics and the level design. Achieving a believable environment was fun challenge.

projects.title: Age of Colonies
projects.shortDesc: One of my greatest projects, an RTS game of ants with an AI system that plays the game by itself using neural networks, inspired by the best RTS game of all time: Age of Empires.

projects.title: Automatic Car Game
projects.shortDesc: A game test where I was supposed to make a car that drives by itself using neural networks, it was a fun challenge and I learned a lot about weights and biases.

projects.title: Zombies game
projects.shortDesc: My first FPS game made in Unity, where I learned a lot about the mechanics of a shooter game and the management of the weapons and projectiles.

projects.title: Drakoron Quest
projects.shortDesc: My first conduction game ever, I implemented a functional gearbox with clutch and all the mechanics of a car. The idea of an arcade racing game with a pursuing dragon could be fun.

projects.title: VR Disaster Simulators
projects.shortDesc: This were demos made for ESRI using their ArcGIS SDK for Unity and the Meta Quest 2 & 3, the goal was to create different disaster simulators in VR using real world data from ArcGIS.

projects.title: Billiard Game
projects.shortDesc: I made a little billiard game using ThreeJS and my own physics library, not perfect but anyway challenging and loved to find solutions to the problems.

projects.title: Shooter VR ThreeJS
projects.shortDesc: A very simple VR shooter made with ThreeJS, it can be played with a VR Box and a smartphone or with a regular screen and mouse.

projects.title: Akali Parkour Animation
projects.shortDesc: A short animation of Akali from League of Legends doing some parkour moves. Everything was animated by hand.

projects.title: Stormtrooper Animation
projects.shortDesc: A short animation of an Stormtrooper from Star Wars clearing a Room. I used myself as reference for the animation. Applied lighting to enhance a lot the atmosphere.
